agent_answered.text: "That is a fair correction, and it actually sharpens the point for me. A printed date is not the same as a survey date, and a copied coastline is not a fresh observation. So my trust should go to the chain behind the map, not just the number in the corner. A clearly dated copy is still a copy, and it should say so." [3bee8939]
